items.summary: These are thirteen things I measured in one sitting. Each one is small. A few of them surprised me anyway. Setup PostgreSQL 18.6, built from source, default settings (work_mem 4MB, shared_buffers 128MB, 2 parallel workers per gather). MacBook Air M5, 10 cores, 24 GB RAM, internal SSD. This is a different machine from my earlier posts, so don't compare times across posts. Most tests use one table of 2,000,000 orders: 50,000 customers, 5% of rows with status open , created_at increasing every 10 seconds, and an md5 string in note . Query times are EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, TIMING OFF) execution time, median of 5 runs after one warm-up run (3…

items.summary: Once a proxy decides which replica should serve a read, it still has to find or create a connection to that replica. This article is about how Polar Proxy organizes its reader connection pool and trims the hot path so that connection handling stops competing with the actual work of answering queries.
